title: An Authorizer from the customer stays when the Bill To changes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with two contacts, contact A1 and contact A2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself, with contact A1 saved as Authorizer.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • Authorizer shows contact A1.

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
  • Authorizer still shows contact A1.
